denominator: fixed norm of exact native float32 candidate minus source, evaluated in float64; also record frozen formal solver u32 norm
dstar: unchanged forensic ideal d64 = promote(formal float32 u)-H64 lambda64; original QP untouched
W0: physical native parameters then formal float32 correction subtraction
W1: restore theta_before; build full float64(theta_before)+dstar64; one final fp32 write
W2: restore theta_before; build float64(theta_before)+float64(formal dstar32); one final fp32 write
old_state_mutation: candidate proposal is generated transactionally once; materialization branches never step optimizer or scheduler and restore all states
top_contributions: top20 by absolute coordinate contribution; report absolute share, signed/net ratio and positive share separately; fractions of coordinates are not energy fractions
rounding_bound: requested +inf spacing at nearest float32 ideal target, plus maximum up/down neighbor gap bound to cover exponent-boundary asymmetry
stage_A_failure: FP32_GRID_FEASIBILITY_NOT_RESOLVED; stop, no120 regression, no repair runs
stage_B: only A passes; same120 starts, all original QP/ref/probe/gates; W1 only; any physical failure blocks supported conclusion
stage_C: only120pass AND previous protection/fidelity gates pass; same corrected candidates, evaluation-only buffer trajectories excluded from references and replay; unavailable explicitly retained
